name: Hugging Face homepage by huggingface.co
description: A white page anchored by two near-black rounded cards — the hero with a live product screenshot bleeding off its right edge, and the Team & Enterprise band mid-page with floating 3D shapes — bookending airy centered sections. Density alternates deliberately: dense three-column trending lists with tiny stat metadata, a bento grid of feature cards embedding real UI mocks (activity feed, code snippet, modality grid, profile), then an airy masonry of open-source library cards carrying star counts as social proof. The yellow mascot is the only saturated accent on an otherwise black/white/gray system, reappearing as a full emoji pile above the footer to close the page playfully.
